description: This file implements the UPSShippingQuote class, which integrates with the UPS online API to provide shipping quotes based on package details and delivery information. It includes methods for validating configuration, constructing XML requests, parsing responses, and handling errors within the UPS shipping estimation process.

classes.name: UPSShippingQuote
classes.description: Main class implementing the ShippingQuoteModule interface, responsible for communicating with UPS API, validating configurations, and returning shipping options.

classes.name: UPSParsedElements
classes.description: Helper class for parsing and storing the response data from UPS API, including status, error messages, and shipping options.

methods.name: validateModuleConfiguration
methods.description: Validates the UPS module configuration parameters such as accessKey, userId, password, and packages.

methods.name: getShippingQuotes
methods.description: Constructs the UPS XML request, sends it via HTTP, parses the response, and returns available shipping options based on packages and delivery details.

methods.name: getCustomModuleConfiguration
methods.description: Returns null; no custom configuration needed for this module.
